tools.name: new_drawing
tools.description: Start a new empty drawing (discards the open one). Sizes are in inches (millimetres are not used; metric only changes the ruler).

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a .vsdx, .drawio or .excalidraw file below the root folder.

tools.name: save
tools.description: Save the drawing as a Visio .vsdx file below the root folder.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Export a page as svg or dxf, or the whole drawing as drawio, or a page as excalidraw. With a path the file is written below the root folder; without one the text is returned.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: The pages of the open drawing with their sizes (inches) and shape counts.

tools.name: list_shapes
tools.description: The shapes of a page: id, type, position (inches, y up from the page bottom), size, rotation (degrees, counter-clockwise), text, fill and line colour.

tools.name: draw_shape
tools.description: Draw a shape from corner (x0, y0) to corner (x1, y1), in inches. kind: rectangle, rounded, ellipse, diamond, triangle, textbox or line. Returns the new shape id. Optional text and style.

style.description: fill, line (#rrggbb), weight (pt), pattern, fontPt, fontFamily, textColor, bold, italic, underline, fillTrans, lineTrans, shadow, beginArrow, endArrow

tools.name: add_connector
tools.description: Glue a connector between two shapes. side: 0 whole shape (default), 1 top, 2 right, 3 bottom, 4 left. Returns the connector id.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Set the text of a shape.

tools.name: style_shapes
tools.description: Style shapes: fill, line (#rrggbb), weight (pt), pattern, fontPt, fontFamily, textColor, bold, italic, underline, fillTrans, lineTrans, shadow, beginArrow, endArrow.

style.description: fill, line (#rrggbb), weight (pt), pattern, fontPt, fontFamily, textColor, bold, italic, underline, fillTrans, lineTrans, shadow, beginArrow, endArrow

tools.name: delete_shapes
tools.description: Delete shapes (and the connectors glued to them follow Visio rules).

tools.name: add_page
tools.description: Add a page after the given page (default: after the last).

tools.name: move_shapes
tools.description: Move shapes by (dx, dy) inches (y up).

tools.name: rotate_shapes
tools.description: Rotate shapes by an angle in degrees, counter-clockwise (the way Visio turns them).

tools.name: flip_shapes
tools.description: Mirror shapes about the vertical axis (or the horizontal one with vertical: true) through the middle of their joint box.

tools.name: align_shapes
tools.description: Align shapes to the first one of ids: left, center, right, top, middle or bottom.

tools.name: distribute_shapes
tools.description: Space three or more shapes evenly, horizontally (default) or vertically.

tools.name: group_shapes
tools.description: Group shapes; returns the group id.

tools.name: ungroup_shape
tools.description: Ungroup a group; its members stay on the page.

tools.name: reorder_shapes
tools.description: Change the drawing order: front, back, forward or backward.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: The connectors of a page with the shapes they are glued to.

tools.name: set_shape_name
tools.description: Name a shape (Visio: Shape.Name). Names are unique on a page: a taken name gets .<shape id> added (the rule Visio uses); an empty name gives the automatic name back. Returns the name the shape has now.

tools.name: set_alt_text
tools.description: Set the alt text of a shape (what it shows, for screen readers; Visio: Shape > Alt Text). An empty text removes it.

tools.name: set_hyperlinks
tools.description: Replace all hyperlinks of a shape. Each link: address (a URL), subAddress, description.

tools.name: set_shape_data
tools.description: Write a Shape Data row: name, value, optional label, type (0 text, 2 number, 3 flag, 5 date).

tools.name: set_page_size
tools.description: Set the size of a page in inches.

tools.name: rename_page
tools.description: Rename a page.

tools.name: duplicate_page
tools.description: Duplicate a page (it is inserted after the original).

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page (the last page cannot be deleted).

tools.name: add_layer
tools.description: Add a layer to a page.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: The layers of a page: index, name, visible, print, locked.

tools.name: set_layer
tools.description: Change a layer (by name): rename it (newName), show / hide it (visible), print / do not print (print), lock / unlock (locked), colour it (color #rrggbb or none).

tools.name: assign_layer
tools.description: Put shapes on a layer (member true, default) or take them off it (member false).

tools.name: delete_layer
tools.description: Delete a layer (its shapes stay and lose the layer).

tools.name: shape_operation
tools.description: Combine shapes into one geometry: union, combine, fragment, intersect, subtract, join or trim (the first shape is the one the others work on). Returns the result.

tools.name: check_diagram
tools.description: Look for things that are usually mistakes on a page: loose connector ends, a second connector between the same two shapes in the same direction (duplicate connector), shapes that no connector touches, overlapping filled shapes and shapes outside the page. Returns [{kind, id, message}]; nothing is changed.

altText.description: also list shapes with neither text nor alt text

allPages.description: check every page (each problem then has a page index)

csv.description: optional path of a CSV file to write below the root folder

tools.name: compare_files
tools.description: Compare two drawing files below the root folder (.vsdx, .drawio or .excalidraw) without touching the open drawing. `file` is the new one, `other` the old one: added = only in `file`, removed = only in `other`, changed = in both but different (text, alt text, position, size, fill, line, rotation). Pages are matched by name, shapes by id (ids of .drawio / .excalidraw files shift when shapes are added or removed, so compare those only for edits that keep the number of shapes). With `csv` the list is also written as a CSV file below the root folder. Returns [{page, pageName, kind, what, id, label, detail}].

csv.description: optional path of a CSV file to write

tools.name: inventory
tools.description: The shapes as a table (the Report of the application): one row per shape of a page (every page with allPages) with Page, Shape ID, Text and each Shape Data row as a column. `columns` picks and orders them (keys: page, id, text, or a Shape Data name; default all). With `csv` the table is also written as a CSV file below the root folder. Returns {columns, rows} (rows are arrays in the order of the columns).

csv.description: optional path of a CSV file to write below the root folder

tools.name: find_shapes
tools.description: Find shapes: `query` matches (case-insensitive, as a part of the text) the text, alt text, name or any Shape Data value of a shape; `dataName` (with an optional `dataValue`, exact, case-insensitive) matches shapes that have that Shape Data row. At least one of query and dataName is required; both must match when both are given. Searches one page (default 0), or every page with allPages. Returns the rows of list_shapes with the page index added.

tools.name: add_border
tools.description: Design > Borders & Titles: put a border (an own design, not a Visio master) beneath a page as a background page: Frame, Double frame, Frame with title block, Title bar. The title is used by the styles that have a title area. Returns {backgroundPage: id}. One undo step. Note: the drawing model shows the background beneath a page as part of the page, so list_shapes then also lists the border shapes (and the title text).

style.description: Frame: A thin frame around the page; Double frame: Two frames, the inner one thinner; Frame with title block: A frame and a title block at the lower right corner; Title bar: A bar with the title along the top edge

tools.name: remove_border
tools.description: Take the border (the background page) off a page; the background page stays in the drawing.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Everything about one page in one answer: index, name, size (inches), number of shapes and connectors, the layers (name, visible, locked) and the background page assigned to it (id, name; null when none). Note: the shape count includes the shapes of an assigned background page (the model shows the background as part of the page).

tools.name: insert_picture
tools.description: Insert a picture file (PNG, JPEG, GIF or BMP, below the root folder) in the box from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) inches. Returns the new shape id.

tools.name: open_stencil
tools.description: Open a stencil (.vssx / .vsdx file below the root folder), or the built-in Basic shapes stencil when no path is given. Returns the stencil number and its masters (id, name).

tools.name: drop_master
tools.description: Drop a master of an open stencil onto a page with its centre at (x, y) inches. Returns the new shape id.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: The gallery themes (name, accent colours, fonts) and the current theme.

tools.name: apply_theme
tools.description: Apply a gallery theme to the whole drawing, or to one page when page is given.

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo the last change.

tools.name: redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone change.
